# Rule quality rubric

Criteria marked ▣ are enforced mechanically by `agentsdir check`; the
others belong to the critique pass (step 4).

## ▣ Mechanical

- ▣ One line in the rules index of AGENTS.md (managed block), derived
  from the when-to-read sentence under the H1 — regenerated by `sync`.
- ▣ No normative reference to a file that does not exist: a dead anchor
  makes the rule lie.

## Critique pass

- Anchored in an OBSERVED failure or a real divergence of the project —
  never a hypothetical fear.
- House template: H1, when-to-read line, imperative tone (ALWAYS, NEVER),
  a GOOD/BAD pair taken from the real failure, tables when useful.
- `paths:` frontmatter when the rule only concerns some files.
- Nothing that a linter, the CI or a hook already enforces mechanically.
- Every line passes the filter question: "if this line is deleted, will the agent make a mistake?"
